messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU pool eu-west-2-gpu queue growth > 95% over 15m, autoscaler heartbeat missed, eviction rate rising. Paging oncall-jamie. link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/6177770000 :rotating_light:

oncall-jamie: I'm on it. seeing queue depth spike to 12k, average latency > 3s, 429s for some requests. pulling logs now.

eng-runtime-alex: fyi I can check autoscaler controller logs and metrics (pool: eu-west-2-gpu). suspect heartbeat agent flapping after last deploy.

sre-lina: confirm - metrics show autoscaler controller dropped heartbeats at 2026-03-14T21:34:11Z -> 21:37:02Z (3m). eviction events started at 21:36.

oncall-jamie: quick triage: are we blocked from scaling up? what does `kubectl get hpa` show for controller?

eng-runtime-alex: running query...

eng-runtime-alex: ```
# autoscaler status
Pool: eu-west-2-gpu
DesiredReplicas: 24
CurrentReplicas: 24
MaxReplicas: 24
AutoscalerLastSeen: 2026-03-14T21:34:11Z
HeartbeatMissing: true
Evictions: 42 (last 10m)
```

prod-ops-maria: oof maxReplicas==24. the pool is at cap. we hit the committed limit. vendors can't provision more without manual increase. customers on Dedicated might be affected.

oncall-jamie: status: scaling blocked by pool max. immediate mitigation options: 1) manual increase maxReplicas for eu-west-2-gpu (requires infra approval) 2) temporarily route burst traffic to fallback pool (eu-central-1-gpu) 3) enable degraded-mode: reduce batch sizes to shed load. Thoughts?

cs-oliver: customers reporting higher 429s. I can send a PSA to affected tenant list if we have ETA.

sre-lina: operational play: (a) disable eviction to avoid killing long-tail requests? risky. (b) bump maxReplicas for emergency window. I'll open infra runbook/issue and request approval.

eng-runtime-alex: logs show autoscaler controller experienced GC/stall around the heartbeat drop. stack trace attached to ticket. possible regress from last runtime change. code ref: commit 9c4d3f.

deploy-bot: Deploy 9c4d3f rolled at 2026-03-14T21:20:03Z to eu-west-2-gpu (canary->all).

oncall-jamie: ok, immediate actions: Lina please request infra to bump pool max to 48 for 30m window. Alex coordinate fallback routing if infra declines. Maria prep customer comms. Oliver, hold on sending until we have ETA <30m.

sre-lina: infra request created: https://infra.redwood/requests/IR-8921 - tagging infra oncall. ETA requested: 15m.

eng-runtime-alex: starting temporary routing: adding traffic-split rule to send low-priority jobs to eu-central-1-gpu. patching route table now.

eng-runtime-alex: ```
# routing change
- route: inference:v2/low-priority -> eu-central-1-gpu (weight 0.5)
- config: prefix-cache disabled for fallback
```

oncall-jamie: monitoring queue after route change...

incident-bot: Alert update: infra oncall accepted IR-8921, manual scale allowed.

sre-lina: manually increased MaxReplicas eu-west-2-gpu 24 -> 48. Triggering immediate scale.

eng-runtime-alex: scaled to 48, pods scheduling. Observability: CPU/GPU utilization now dropping from 98% -> 72% over 4m. queue depth slowly decreasing.

prod-ops-maria: marking affected customers for follow-up: tenant-42, tenant-88, tenant-plg-alpha. CS ready with templated note.

cs-oliver: sending targeted PSA to tenant-42 and tenant-88 now: "We observed elevated request errors/latency due to capacity constraints in eu-west-2. We scaled capacity; service recovery in progress. We'll follow up w/ root cause and ETA for mitigation."

oncall-jamie: recovery signs: 429s dropping, tail-latency improving. still watching evictions metric. need root cause/next steps.

sre-lina: immediate RC hypothesis: autoscaler missed heartbeats due to controller GC/stall after deploy 9c4d3f, plus pool was pinned at MaxReplicas so no automatic scale. two independent failures -> outage.

eng-runtime-alex: reproduction path: if autoscaler controller doesn't write heartbeat for >2m, eviction policy triggers. we've got a race when maxReplicas==currentReplicas. fix ideas: 1) make controller tolerant to transient GC (graceful heartbeat backpressure) 2) emergency queue-growth path to temporarily raise maxReplicas or borrow from reserved slack pool 3) alerting: add Alert when pool at max and heartbeat missing simultaneously.

prod-ops-maria: can we add a short-term automated rollback of 9c4d3f to canary-only? risky during remediation.

eng-runtime-alex: prefer to patch controller to tolerate GC; rollback may be quicker but could reintroduce previous bug. propose hotfix to add heartbeat retry window and to avoid eviction if cluster-wide free GPUs > 5 and scaling still possible.

sre-lina: agreed. action items logged.

sre-lina: Action items (brief):
- A1: Hotfix autoscaler heartbeat retry (eng-runtime) - owner: alex - ETA: 48h
- A2: Add alert: pool_at_max && heartbeat_missing (sre) - owner: lina - ETA: 2h
- A3: Emergency-bump playbook to allow 1-click maxReplicas increase to +100% for 30m (prod-ops/infra) - owner: maria - ETA: 72h
- A4: Postmortem with timeline and customer impact (all) - owner: jamie - ETA: 24h
- A5: CS follow-up messages & credits for affected tenants - owner: oliver - ETA: 24h

oncall-jamie: I'm taking A4 draft. will include logs, timeline, and mitigations.

cs-oliver: I've queued the PSAs, will add a follow-up with remediation and credits after postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager resolved at 2026-03-14T21:48:00Z. pool utilization back to normal ranges.

eng-runtime-alex: note: creating branch hotfix/autoscaler-heartbeat-retry and starting work. link: https://scm.redwood/r/1234

sre-lina: temporary follow-up: enable alert to page oncall quicker if heartbeat missing >1m and pool at >90% util.

prod-ops-maria: scheduling cross-team async postmortem review tomorrow 09:00 UTC. invite sent.

oncall-jamie: closing thread for now. tagging owners on action items. thanks team :heart:
